text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whew...!
Tannhauser, you're looking awfully energetic today~

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Today is a slightly special day...
It's 'Munmun Day,' after all."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Munmun Day" is a day where my family's shop gives away free side dishes.
Like meatballs, or fried chicken.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, I was so busy helping out too.
Whenever it's discount day, my body just gets all pumped up with a 'Mun-mun!' on its own."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And so... today, I'm even going to
ask for seconds on training!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, don't push yourself too hard...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't see anything anymore.
'Munmun Day' is truly terrifying..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Watch out, right there!
There's a dip in the ground!"
